title: Add Google Analytics or a Meta Pixel
blurb: Track your Luubu website visitors in Google Analytics or for Facebook ads.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open External Tracking
steps.body: Click **External Tracking** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Which tool where
steps.body: External Tracking is for sites outside Luubu. For your Luubu website or funnel, GA4 and Meta Pixel code goes in the site's own settings.

steps.title: Get your code
steps.body: Copy your GA4 tag from Google Analytics (Admin, Data streams) or your pixel code from Meta Events Manager.

steps.title: Open Sites
steps.body: Click **Sites** in the left menu, then open your website or funnel.

steps.title: Open its settings
steps.body: Open the site's **Settings** and find the head tracking code box.

steps.title: Paste and save
steps.body: Paste the code into the head tracking box, save, and republish the site.
steps.tip: Check it works with Google Tag Assistant or Meta Pixel Helper.
